t: This is Ulster Terrace, a Grade I listed terrace designed by John Nash. Nash was a British architect of the Georgian and Regency eras, and he designed many important areas of London in the neoclassical and picturesque styles. His work was financed by the Prince Regent and by the property developer James Burton. He also collaborated extensively with Burton's son, Decimus Burton. Take a moment to look at the facade as part of that larger Regency scheme.
